_comment: slider_to_linear sampled straight out of the noise machine, by scripts/probes/cliff-slider-to-linear, against Factorio 2.1.17 (build 87315, mac-arm64, steam) on 2026-09-05. The probe registers `slider_to_linear(x, lo, hi)` as the elevation property, so the capture positions ARE the slider positions; `y` picks the range. Settles #324: narrowing the BOUNDS to f32 before use scores 39/39 exact, the shipped per-operation form without that narrowing scores 31/39, and the plain-f64 copy that used to live in cliffCatalog.ts scores 5/39 and fails a control.
